rounds.text: Jattashankar Industries Ltd trades at an astronomical P/E ratio of 177x according to filed statements [E1], which surges further to 186.27x against a negligible sector benchmark of 9.38x [E6]. This extreme valuation is completely disconnected from the company's underlying fundamentals, highlighted by a meager 5.4% ROE [E13] and a dismal 10-year compounded profit growth rate of -7% [E18]. Long-term operational performance reveals deep-seated structural weakness, evidenced by a 10-year median return on equity of just 4% [E26] and a stagnant 3-year median ROE of 1% [E28]. Furthermore, shareholders receive zero income support as the dividend yield sits firmly at 0.00% [E4], leaving them entirely exposed to a towering price-to-book multiple of 9.35x [E2]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months is 176% [E21].
